name: freetier_gate
summary: The ONLY auth gate between the two public callback URLs (GentlyOS.io for free-tier, trollz.fun for TROLLN-tier) and the proprietary MCP surface. Issues HMAC-SHA256 signed tokens after a user accepts terms+policies. Records every acceptance in a sqlite ledger at studio/auth/freetier_acceptances.sqlite AND crystal-anchors each event as tier='legal_acceptance' for court/audit reconstruction. Per-domain scoping default (TROLLN token rejected if expected GentlyOS.io and vice versa).
engine_pattern: Stdlib-only token codec: header.payload.sig where each part is base64url. HMAC-SHA256 over MYSPACE_KEY_MASTER (from studio/auth/keys.master_secret()). Per-user/per-domain acceptance row in sqlite — ON CONFLICT UPDATE keeps latest acceptance. Token format JWT-shaped but kind='freetier_v1' to distinguish from any future token classes.

env_vars.MYSPACE_KEY_MASTER: Master HMAC secret (32 bytes). Falls back to keys.master_secret() then to deterministic project-hash for dev

substrate: studio/auth/freetier_acceptances.sqlite (per-user-per-domain ledger) + crystal chain entries tier='legal_acceptance' model='callback_handler' scope='acceptance_<domain_underscored>'

inbound_callers: core/lib/model_api.py (D.1 — verifies token on every /v1/* request)
core/lib/third_party/generative_mcp.py (D.4 — verifies before any external call)
outbound_calls: sqlite at studio/auth/freetier_acceptances.sqlite (INSERT ON CONFLICT UPDATE)

smoke_test_results_2026_05_28.verify_match: ok — claims returned with correct user_id/domain/tier
smoke_test_results_2026_05_28.verify_cross_domain_reject: ok — trollz token rejected for expected=GentlyOS.io
smoke_test_results_2026_05_28.ledger_persistence: ok — sqlite shows both rows with crystal_id full hash
smoke_test_results_2026_05_28.crystal_chain_audit: ok — 2 legal_acceptance entries (one per domain) chained

guarantees: Token is HMAC-bound to MYSPACE_KEY_MASTER — cannot be forged without master secret
Per-domain scoping by default — TROLLN token never honored on GentlyOS.io and vice versa
Idempotent — re-acceptance updates the row, doesn't duplicate
Crystal-audit-trail — every acceptance has a deterministic crystal_id linking to chain entry
Stdlib-only — no PyJWT or cryptography deps; uses hmac + hashlib + base64
usage_example:
from core.lib.freetier_gate import issue_token, verify_token, record_acceptance
# On callback endpoint:
crystal = record_acceptance(user_id, 'GentlyOS.io', ip=client_ip, user_agent=ua)
token = issue_token(user_id, 'GentlyOS.io', accepted_terms_hash=hash_of_terms_html)
# On any later API request:
claims = verify_token(extracted_bearer, expected_domain='GentlyOS.io')
if claims is None: return 401
# else proceed; claims.tier / claims.user_id are trusted
phase: Public-vs-private architecture foundation (the only gate between callback URLs and proprietary MCPs)
